USAGE:
  sediment report compute [-h] [--org ORG] [--since-days SINCE_DAYS] [--json]
                          [--rows-out FILE] [--database-url DATABASE_URL]

  Compare Session completion time across final Compute allocations.

OPTIONS:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --org ORG             org id (default: $SEDIMENT_ORG_ID)
  --since-days SINCE_DAYS
                        window Compute allocations (and their Session timings)
                        to the last N days by capture time; default: all history
  --json                emit JSON instead of a text report
  --rows-out FILE       write one Session compute timing per line to FILE as
                        JSONL
  --database-url DATABASE_URL
                        PostgreSQL URL (default: $SEDIMENT_DATABASE_URL)
